double_buffer.exact_behavior: The helper reads field +8, toggles it as a boolean, selects block[active_index], and publishes stop latch 1 when its callback path returns no record.

lifecycle.initialization: Selector dispatch installs workspace 0x800CAEE8. Player entry stores the signed mode/limit, clears completion, active index, rect-ready state and initializes both RECT slots.
lifecycle.reuse: 0x800B6C24 toggles only active_index and selects exactly one of two allocated block pointers.
lifecycle.retirement: Player teardown stops CD/audio callbacks, frees the three allocation-result pointers at 0x800CABE0/0x800CABE4/0x800CABEC, then returns before Region B may be replaced.
lifecycle.residency_rule: Every address in this table is valid only while the exact FMV.BIN head identity is resident.

player_typed_state.boundary: This exhaustively types direct absolute accesses within the three declared decode/player/selector state ranges, including widths, signed views, valid branches, initialization/reuse/retirement and local resident dependencies. Internal MDEC tables and SDK-private callback records outside those ranges remain source/interface owners and are not presented as MOD state.
